notes: The only discount-style merchandising on this site is a highlighted top-nav item labeled plainly 'Sale' (main-navigation__item--highlight), with four genuine children: All Sale (278 products, https://www.auraliving.com/ae/c/collections/all-sale), Furniture Sale (133, .../furniture-sale), Tableware Sale (47, .../tableware-sale), Bed and Bath Sale (73, .../bed-and-bath-sale), Decor Sale (73, .../decor-sale) -- verified as real product listings via Nuxt SSR __NUXT__ ProductQueryAura pagination.total. Applied the CLEARANCE VS. SALE test from brief §3 plus the project's UAE-regional-campaign caveat (checked specifically for DSS/'Dubai Summer'/campaign-tied wording). Searched every page's HTML for clearance-taxonomy signal words -- 'clearance', 'outlet', 'final sale', 'last chance', 'end of season', 'discontinued', 'permanent' -- and campaign/temporary-promo signal words -- 'DSS', 'Dubai Summer', 'sale ends', 'offer ends', 'limited time', '% off' -- every one of these returned 0 hits on the All Sale page (and page <title>/meta description is the bare string 'All Sale | Aura'). There is no on-page copy of any kind describing permanence (outlet/end-of-line/discontinued) NOR any explicit temporary-campaign copy -- the nav item is simply named 'Sale' with no further qualifier either way. Per brief §3 ('a page called Sale ... should NOT be automatically classified as Clearance' unless the site's own taxonomy clearly treats it as Clearance/Outlet/Final Clearance/Last Chance/End of Line), and given zero clearance-taxonomy wording was found anywhere, this is treated as a generic Sale section and excluded, not as an ambiguous clearance case -- there is no positive signal pointing toward 'clearance' to make it ambiguous, only the bare label 'Sale'. Also probed direct URL guesses /ae/c/clearance, /ae/c/collections/clearance, /ae/c/outlet, /ae/c/collections/outlet, /ae/c/collections/final-sale, /ae/c/collections/last-chance -- all 404. Also checked footer nav (Info/Help links only, no product sections) and the full Storyblok collection-slug inventory from the homepage payload -- no slug uses clearance/outlet/final-sale/last-chance wording. Conclusion: no genuine Clearance-type merchandising PLP exists on this site; the 'Sale' section found is a generic promotional listing, correctly excluded per the Sale-vs-Clearance rule.
